name: Memento
summary: Captures and externalizes an object's internal state, without violating encapsulation, so that the object can be restored to that state later.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Originator
roles.summary: Creates a memento of its own state, and uses one to restore itself.

roles.name: Memento
roles.summary: Holds the captured state, and exposes it only to its originator.

roles.name: Caretaker
roles.summary: Keeps mementos safe, and never inspects or alters their content.
